mapper.select: SELECT id,label AS "supplierName" FROM vendor ORDER BY id
SELECT id,title,unit_price AS "price" FROM goods ORDER BY id
SELECT id,label,city FROM buyer ORDER BY id

SELECT i.id AS "itemId",g.title AS "productName",v.label AS "supplierName",i.serial_code AS "serialNo", CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN '未售出' ELSE '已售出' END AS "state" FROM inventory i JOIN goods g ON g.id=i.goods_id JOIN vendor v ON v.id=i.vendor_id LEFT JOIN purchase p ON p.item_id=i.id ORDER BY i.id

SELECT v.id AS "supplierId",v.label AS "supplierName",g.id AS "productId",g.title AS "productName" FROM vendor_goods r JOIN vendor v ON v.id=r.vendor_id JOIN goods g ON g.id=r.goods_id ORDER BY v.id,g.id

SELECT p.id AS "saleId",i.id AS "itemId",i.serial_code AS "serialNo",g.id AS "productId",g.title AS "productName", v.id AS "supplierId",v.label AS "supplierName",b.id AS "customerId",b.label AS "customerName",p.paid AS "salePrice",p.sold_on AS "soldOn" FROM purchase p JOIN inventory i ON i.id=p.item_id JOIN goods g ON g.id=i.goods_id JOIN vendor v ON v.id=i.vendor_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id=p.buyer_id AND g.id=#{productId}AND v.id=#{supplierId}AND b.id=#{customerId} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT DISTINCT g.id AS "productId",g.title AS "productName" FROM goods g JOIN inventory i ON i.goods_id=g.id JOIN purchase p ON p.item_id=i.id WHERE i.vendor_id=#{id} ORDER BY g.id
SELECT DISTINCT b.id AS "customerId",b.label AS "customerName" FROM buyer b JOIN purchase p ON p.buyer_id=b.id JOIN inventory i ON i.id=p.item_id WHERE i.vendor_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.id
SELECT DISTINCT b.id AS "customerId",b.label AS "customerName" FROM buyer b JOIN service_event e ON e.buyer_id=b.id WHERE e.vendor_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.id
SELECT e.id,e.description,b.label AS "customerName",e.happened_on AS "serviceDate" FROM service_event e JOIN buyer b ON b.id=e.buyer_id WHERE e.vendor_id=#{id} ORDER BY e.id
SELECT id,label FROM vendor WHERE id=#{id}
